topic_title: Environmental Hazards — Low-Water, Fog, Ice & Wind
prompt: Which vehicles are most vulnerable to sudden dangerous wind gusts when crossing Texas bridges?

options.text: High-profile vehicles, RVs, trucks pulling trailers, and passenger vans
Low-slung subcompact hybrid passenger sedans driving below speed limits
Motor vehicles equipped with four-wheel antilock disc brake calipers
Vehicles carrying heavy concrete bags inside the bottom luggage trunk
